title: Hayna
description: Hayna was the daughter of General Strix, the warlord of the Troiks, one of the warring tribes of At Achrann. She led teams of other kids along the wastelands, and one day came along Wim, KB, Fern, and Neel after they arrived. While the others trained, she and Neel had a deep conversation about the nature of war and peace.
